categories.main_business_segments: Hwatsing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of high-end semiconductor equipment, including CMP (Chemical Mechanical Polishing) equipment, thinning equipment, cutting equipment, edge polishing equipment, ion implantation equipment, wet process equipment, wafer regeneration, and key consumables and maintenance services. Their products serve integrated circuits, advanced packaging, large silicon wafers, third-generation semiconductors, MEMS, and MicroLED manufacturing processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core proprietary technologies such as nano-level polishing, nano-particle ultra-clean cleaning, nano-precision film thickness online detection, big data analysis and intelligent control, and ultra-precision thinning. They develop advanced CMP systems, integrated thinning and polishing machines, wafer cutting and edge polishing equipment, and ion implantation systems. Production methods include modular design, order-based and inventory-based manufacturing, and strict quality control systems certified by ISO9001:2015 and SEMI standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hwatsing serves major integrated circuit manufacturers and research institutes, including leading domestic clients like SMIC, Yangtze Memory Technologies, Huahong Group, and Changxin Memory. Their products are widely used in logic chips, memory chips, advanced packaging, large silicon wafers, third-generation semiconductors, MEMS, and MicroLED sectors. The company’s customer base is concentrated but includes multiple top-tier semiconductor fabs in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China, with subsidiaries in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shanghai-based Xinrui Semiconductor. Sales are predominantly domestic, with some sales in bonded zones. The company is expanding production capacity and R&D facilities mainly within China, aiming to increase its global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hwatsing operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a high-end semiconductor equipment manufacturer. It supplies critical manufacturing equipment and related consumables and services to downstream integrated circuit manufacturers and packaging companies. The company also engages in wafer regeneration services, supporting the recycling and reuse of semiconductor wafers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment focused on CMP equipment upgrades, thinning and cutting equipment, ion implantation technology, and wet process equipment. It emphasizes developing advanced process capabilities for 12-inch and 8-inch wafers, advanced packaging technologies like 2.5D/3D IC, and expanding wafer regeneration services. Hwatsing also invests in domestic core component development to ensure supply chain security and collaborates with academic institutions like Tsinghua University.
categories.revenue_model: Hwatsing generates revenue primarily through direct sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related consumables. It also earns income from technical services, maintenance, upgrades, and wafer regeneration contract manufacturing. The company uses a direct sales model with contracts signed directly with customers, supplemented by after-sales service and consumable sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hwatsing holds a leading domestic position in CMP equipment for 12-inch wafers, competing against international giants like Applied Materials and Ebara, which historically dominated the global market. In thinning and cutting equipment, the company is catching up to Japanese leaders like DISCO. Hwatsing is recognized as a national champion and a specialized 'little giant' enterprise in China’s semiconductor equipment industry, with growing market share and technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hwatsing achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.4 billion, a 35.82% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.02 billion, up 41.40%. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 6.4 billion, with significant growth driven by expanded production capacity, increased sales, and government subsidies. R&D expenditure rose by nearly 30% to RMB 393.8 million, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hwatsing emphasizes its core proprietary technologies, high product performance, and quality, offering advanced CMP and semiconductor equipment tailored to meet the needs of advanced process nodes and packaging technologies. Its competitive advantages include a comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, localized and responsive after-sales service, and a secure domestic supply chain for critical components. The company’s platform strategy integrates equipment and services, enhancing customer value and supporting sustainable growth.
